assets.style: Painterly cinematic illustration, mystical and dramatic, deep violet and indigo night with radiant gold light, high contrast, vertical 9:16 composition with one clear subject in the center, no text, no letters, no watermark.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: 당신은 슬픔인가요? <#0.3#> 아니면, 슬픔을 느끼는 누군가인가요?
voices.caption: 당신은 슬픔인가요? 아니면, 슬픔을 느끼는 누군가인가요?

voices.name: l02
voices.text: 먹구름이 아무리 짙어도, <#0.2#> 하늘은 더러워지지 않아요.
voices.caption: 먹구름이 아무리 짙어도, 하늘은 더러워지지 않아요.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: 밀어내지 말고, <#0.2#> 아, 지금 슬프구나, 하고 받아들이세요.
voices.caption: 밀어내지 말고, 아, 지금 슬프구나, 하고 받아들이세요.

images: a woman sitting by a rain-streaked window at night, a dark grey cloud of sorrow hovering around her shoulders, a calm soft golden light glowing at the center of her chest
a vast glowing sky at dawn with dark storm clouds drifting through it, the sky behind them clean, luminous and endless
the same woman with her hand on her heart, eyes closed, the grey cloud around her softening and thinning into mist
dark clouds parting over a calm sea, a clear golden sky opening wide behind them

animate.motion: the dark clouds slowly part and drift away, golden light pours across the calm sea
